apps.name: Ship of Harkinian
apps.subtitle: Ocarina of Time for iPhone & Vision Pro
apps.localizedDescription: The Ship of Harkinian port of The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time, running natively on Metal — the full quest with saves, the enhancements menu, texture-pack support, and on Apple Vision Pro a stereoscopic 3D mode. Ships with no game content: you supply your own Ocarina of Time ROM and the app extracts it on device.

versions.localizedDescription:
First public release of Ship of Harkinian (The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time) for iPhone and Apple Vision Pro — a native Metal port.

**Features**
- Full quest with saves, audio and music, and cutscenes
- The Ship of Harkinian enhancements menu (higher frame rates, widescreen, quality-of-life toggles)
- In-app ROM extraction — no PC tools needed
- Game controllers with menu-aware navigation, plus a tunable on-screen touch layout (including per-button hide/show)
- 60 / 120 Hz (ProMotion) and a supersampling slider
- Texture-pack (`.o2r`) support via drag-and-drop in Files
- **Apple Vision Pro:** a true-4K windowed mode plus a world-locked **stereoscopic 3D mode** with foveated rendering and spatial audio

**Install:** add the SideStore source and install — see the [README](https://github.com/rebelancap/Shipwright-ios#install). Bring your own Ocarina of Time ROM; no game content is included.
